test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following festivals is not celebrated in Uttar Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nuakhai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nuakhai **is a **harvest festival **celebrated mainly in **western Odisha** and some parts of **Chhattisgarh **and **Jharkhand **and is celebrated with great enthusiasm and fervor.
 
• It marks the **beginning of the harvest season** and is a time of thanksgiving and celebration.
 
• The day following the Ganesh Chaturthi celebration, it is **celebrated on panchami tithi**, or the fifth day, of the lunar fortnight in the month of **Bhadrapada or Bhadraba (August–September).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Taj Mahotsav** is a festival celebrated in **Agra, Uttar Pradesh**, to **showcase the rich cultural heritage** of the state.

 
 
• It is a **10-day festival **that showcases the art, craft, and culture of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It is held **annually in February-March** and attracts a large number of tourists from all over the world.
 
 
 
• **Ganga Festival** is celebrated in **Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh,** to celebrate the holy river Ganges and its significance in Hindu mythology.
 
 
• It is celebrated in the** month of November **and is a major attraction for tourists who come to witness the grand celebrations and take a dip in the holy river Ganges.
 
 
 
• **Buddha Festival** is celebrated in **Sarnath, Uttar Pradesh, **to **commemorate the birth, enlightenment, and death of Lord Buddha.**
 
 
• It is celebrated in** Sarnath, which is a famous pilgrimage site for Buddhists.**
 
• It is held **annually in December** and is a major event for Buddhists from all over the world.
